newsitem.title: CHINA: China rural credit co-op savings 879 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China rural credit co-op savings 879 bln in 1996.

text.p: Savings in China's rural credit cooperatives hit 879.4 billion yuan ($106 billion) at the end of 1996, the Beijing-backed Ta Kung Pao newspaper said on Wednesday.
Loans given out by the cooperatives totalled 629 billion yuan at the end of March this year, said the newspaper, which is based in Hong Kong.
Total assets of the cooperatives reached 1.4 trillion yuan at the end of last year, the newspaper said.
About 80 percent of loans to rural families and 70 percent of loans to village and township enterprises came from rural credit cooperatives, it said.
China employed some 600,000 people in more than 2,400 cooperatives at the county level and in more than 50,000 at the grass-roots level, it said but gave no further details.
